Collaborate with your teammates on different missions with varying difficulty levels, and objectives that can change depending on the map and the creature.

Examine the evidence found on the ship to identify the creature you're facing and figure out how to eliminate it. Solve puzzles and find the weapon that will help you during the boss fight.

Survive at all costs. Use the environment to your advantage and make use of tools like the motion detector, shield, or mini-map to navigate the ship without getting killed. Adopt the right group strategy to eradicate or capture the creatures.

notes.title: Propagation: Paradise Hotel FAQ
notes.notes:
[h2]There are only 6 days left before [b][i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel [/i][/b]kicks off and we thought it might be a good time to answer a few of your recurrent questions about the game. Hopefully we cover most of it ![/h2]


[h2][b]IS IT GONNA BE SCARY ?[/b][/h2]
YES. I’m not gonna lie, your stay at the Paradise Hotel will be a little… uncomfortable if I may say. It will be overwhelming and there will be blood. But the thing that is gonna be persistent is the extreme tension. Be prepared to jump out of your skin and hide somewhere safe ! 

[h2][b]IS IT A STATIC WAVE SHOOTER ?[/b][/h2]
NO. How can you find Ashley in the Paradise Hotel without moving ? Get your best shoes on and get ready to move, well at least in the game. But we know some of you might apprehend motion sickness, this is why we’ve included the teleportation option.

[h2][b]IS IT GONNA BE HARD ?[/b][/h2]
IT CAN BE. Obviously we want the Paradise Hotel to be as welcoming as it can be. Whether you are looking for a quiet exploration or a harder challenge, you will be able to choose from 4 difficulty levels : Easy - Normal - Hard - Nightmare. Hopefully it will let all of you have an enjoyable experience. 

[h2][b]HOW MUCH TIME DOES IT TAKE TO FINISH THE GAME ? [/b][/h2]
Depending on how easily scared or distracted by the Hotel’s lovely surroundings you are, you can expect a few hours of tension. But from what we’ve seen so far, the average player will complete the game in about 4 hours on a standard difficulty. It could take up to 7 hours to get all achievements done. Don’t hesitate to tell us about your experience on [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS][u]Discord[/u][/url] !

[h2][b]IS THERE A CO-OP MODE ?[/b][/h2]
NO. And for one reason only, we wanted to create an immersive experience where the player is the only hero of the story. You won’t be able to count on anybody else but yourself to survive inside the Paradise Hotel, and trust me it’s gonna be a real journey.

[h2][b]HOW MUCH IS THE GAME ?[/b][/h2]
Don’t be afraid of the not so clean bedsheets and the lack of food, book your stay at the Paradise Hotel for $19.99 (19,99€). Just make sure to be well fed and well rested before playing and everything will go fine !

notes.title: Propagation: Paradise Hotel launches on May 4th
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone, [/h1]

We are very excited to share with you guys that [i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/i] will launch on May 4th. We decided to produce a proper cinematic trailer for this special occasion. It has been a work in progress for a while but we are ready to let you enjoy it.

[previewyoutube=4J6NTGz3II8;full][/previewyoutube]

As you might already know, [i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/i] is a [b]solo VR adventure[/b] in which the player will be emotionally challenged through an anxious and horrifying atmosphere. Our goal is to propose an immersive experience inside the Paradise Hotel where Emily is desperate to find her twin sister Ashley.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/82898cf33110d5df0070ade77eaf7ed55ff774a0.png[/img]

The player will have to explore every corner of the Hotel, especially the darkest ones, in order to gather resources, key items and solve some puzzles. As many of you have noticed, we have shown you some of the worst encounters you can expect in the Paradise Hotel. However, there may be worse things lurking in the hotel.

[b]Also in this video[/b], we have shown you that new gameplay mechanics, such as the use of tools will help you to get out of this nightmare. notes.title: Item gathering explained
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/855a6cecdb9681a2a0c47acd5a80ec240a2fd4d9.png[/img]

[h1]Further in the gameplay mechanics[/h1]

First of all, we want to thank everyone who is following [i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel’[/i]s development. Day after day, you are more and more numerous to add this experience to your wishlist and it makes us even prouder of our work. As an indie studio, this proximity with you means a lot!

As we said [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1824960/view/3391799364895087465]in our last steam hub post[/url], the game is now at an advanced state of development and now, we feel more comfortable to share content about our work, as shown in this article about the item gathering mechanic.

[u][h2]Gathering and managing resources[/h2][/u]
All along your adventure in the Paradise Hotel, you will have to use the gathered resources wisely. There are three different resources: [b]Ammunition, Antiseptic and Batteries.[/b] Let's have a look at how you will have to use them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/ad6b12f0f61560d0192a6420daac60137beb0c08.png[/img][u][h3]Piece of advice: never run out of ammo[/h3][/u]
As we already showed you in a previous blog post about the gun mechanic, ammunition will have a key role in your adventure. Read more about gun mechanic here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1363430/view/3403058363948329056
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/6703a8a87aac0b04b3dc477a3487f531568c8199.gif[/img]

In Propagation:Paradise Hotel, you'll have to gather ammunition by finding it in different places (lockers, drawers...).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/c2c1be1b6648820075f0a9964231295cd399fcd4.gif[/img]

[u][h3]Your flashlight is your best friend.[/h3][/u]
A you can imagine, you'll probably find yourself in dark environments while exploring the Paradise Hotel. In such situations, make sure you always have batteries for your flashlight to keep progressing through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/0f7b57d847bd1ae20297734ddfe5a14074fc76cd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/228566750fa62bbc6d6721c7ba7dbf82c552ad17.png[/img]

Using your flashlight will quickly drain its battery and you will have to insert a new one if you don't want to stay in the darkness. Wisely managing  the use of your flashlight is great advice to move forward in the Paradise Hotel. Since we work on VR experiences, the power of a light beam in dark environments will undoubtedly create a more nerve-wracking atmosphere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/42b157199c6e911f1b4f8cd86b9ed0c339a7fe1d.png[/img]

[u][h3]Don't go out without your spray![/h3][/u]
During your [i]stay[/i] in the Paradise Hotel, some encounters may be painful. You'll need enough antiseptic to heal you from bleeding. Using antiseptic vials to reload your healing spray will guarantee that you reach the next step of the adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/aa70e1375659b2ea74c9e5ddde369ed347da20f1.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/bf1f44f64c92021ae04e8287e697c3e4704c33ab.png[/img]

To conclude, you will find all these resources in limited number! It will be very important for you to manage these resources. Running out of ammo or battery for your lamp will certainly create very stressful situations where each one of your decisions will be important! 

[h3]As always, thank you so much for your support![/h3]

The whole team of WanadevStudio is focused on working on the VR experience you want to play. We are doing our best to improve each component of our previous work and as a small indie studio, it takes time. 

We warmly thank you for all the kindness you sent us on every channels. We cant wait to share you more footage videos.

notes.title: Gun gameplay explained
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone! Until the launch of Propagation: Paradise Hotel, we want to show you the game more from "inside". [/h1]

[h3][b]In this first topic, we're going to focus on one of the most anticipated mechanics of this upcoming game: the Gun gameplay! [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/1619118dff6815eb9d6b65ee3870649b74f412e9.gif[/img]

Our goal with Propagation: Paradise Hotel is to offer a scary experience while providing a simple, yet complete mechanic. As the Wii was at one time, VR allows us to offer an experience that is closer to reality and fun.

That's why making the reloading system more complex than in PropagationVR became a logical evolution, in order to move away from the Arcade style of the first opus and to get much closer to the oppressive atmosphere present in the survival horror game style.

[h3][b]This reloading mechanic is definitely the feature you asked us for the most! That's why we made it a point to take care of it and go in that direction.  [/b][/h3]

But we wanted to go further than that! The gun and its mechanics should be an integral part of the atmosphere of the game, making the feature more complex brings a strong tension in the fight scenes. So you'll have to overcome your fear and the stress of the situation to get through it! 

We relied a lot on the concepts of Shinji Mikami (game designer of the Resident Evil series) to make the basis of our gun gameplay. One of his key concepts is that [i]the player should have new stages of difficulty and horror as soon as he has mastered one[/i]. We definitely wanted the gun to be one of the steps to completing your adventure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/4cc286bd7877eddfc36f2b21013ac997cd760136.png[/img] 

[h3][b]During our 1st gameplay teaser (find it here: [url=www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEkFKsEyoJM]www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEkFKsEyoJM[/url]) many of you told us that the "T-Cup" grip was not optimal and very little used in the handling of a firearm.[/b][/h3] 

So we put ourselves in the shoes of Emily, the main character of this adventure. And what would a civil with a gun do, if not repeat what he saw in a movie? 

So we decided to leave this grip for people who like her would do this instinctively. 

However, you may encounter people who are experts in handling weapons in Propagation: Paradise Hotel... But we'll save that for another topic which is available here :

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1363430/announcements/detail/3403058363948329057

[b]Thank you so much for your support!

If you want to know more about the universe of Propagation: Paradise Hotel and follow the development of the game, please wishlist it here : [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824960/Propagation_Paradise_Hotel/

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url] and our dedicated [url=https://twitter.com/PropagationVR]Propagation Twitter[/url] to chat with us! 

See you soon!
